text: If you're into unique fragrances, rooftops, and matcha, this is exactly the spot for you. I finally got to check out Oloria, which is a Korean perfumery located on a rooftop in K-Town. It's in this beautiful historic building, and the architecture is just so stunning to look at. All of their scents draw inspiration from Korean nature and culture, and I feel like they really have something for everyone. They have such a wide variety of different scents. I loved how unique all of these scents were. It was like stuff that we had never smelled before, and as people who collect fragrance, that definitely says a lot. The workers were also super helpful at walking us through which scents they thought would be best for us based on our preferences. But I'd have to say these two are my favorite because I am a gourmand girl. They also have a cafe that serves drinks that go with each scent that they sell, which I think is so genius and unique. We decided to go with Jeong, which was an iced cold brew served with soy sauce cold foam. We also ordered Heaven, which is a matcha with a jasmine cream top. They also give you these little scent cards of the scent that goes with the drink, so you're supposed to smell it and then take a sip, which I think is really fun and immersive. It was such a nice day out, so we enjoyed our drinks on this rooftop that they have connected to the store. And I'm not gonna lie, because these drinks were $10 each, I wanted to hate them so bad, but these were actually some of the best matcha and coffee drinks I have had in a minute. I'm very picky when it comes to my matcha, and this one was a 10 out of 10. It was so rich and so creamy, and I would also recommend the coffee. It was a perfect balance of sweet and salty. Even if you don't like perfume and you just want a good drink with a nice view, I definitely recommend this spot.
